events.name: San Diego Padres at Cincinnati Reds

leaders.displayValue: 1-3, HR, 3 RBI, R, BB, SB, K

headlines.description: — Rookie Juan Brito hit his first home run, JJ Bleday and Héctor Rodríguez also went deep and the Cincinnati Reds scored seven unanswered runs to beat the San Diego Padres 7-3 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brito, Bleday and Rodríguez homer, Reds score 7 unanswered runs to beat Padres 7-3

headlines.description: — Ronald Acuña Jr. hit a three-run homer to become the fastest player in major league history to reach 200 home runs and 200 stolen bases, and the Atlanta Braves beat the Washington Nationals 9-0 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ronald Acuña Jr. becomes fastest to 200 homers, 200 steals as Braves beat Nationals 9-0

headlines.description: — Henry Bolte had his first career multihomer game, Zack Gelof, Jonah Heim and Alika Williams also went deep, and the Athletics scored nine unanswered runs to beat the Texas Rangers 9-2 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bolte's first career multihomer game leads Athletics over Rangers 9-2

headlines.description: — Brett Sullivan’s two-out, two-run single capped Colorado’s 11th-inning comeback, and the Rockies beat the Baltimore Orioles 6-5 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brett Sullivan's 2-run single in the 11th lifts the Rockies to a 6-5 win over the Orioles

headlines.description: — James McCann hit a solo homer in the eighth inning, seven Arizona pitchers combined for a shutout and the Diamondbacks avoided a three-game sweep by beating the Philadelphia Phillies 1-0 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: James McCann's solo homer in the 8th inning sends D-backs to a 1-0 win over the Phillies

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Jhonny Pereda had a two-run single as part of the second of Seattle’s two four-run innings on the day, and the Mariners beat the Boston Red Sox 8-3 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jhonny Pereda has 2 RBIs, Mariners roll past Red Sox 8-3

events.name: New York Mets at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Rookie Nick Morabito had a three-run double for his first major league hit and later made a sparkling defensive play in left field, helping the New York Mets beat the Tampa Bay Rays 10-4 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Morabito sparks Mets with 3-run double for first hit, makes dazzling catch in 10-4 win vs. Rays

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Rafael Devers continued his hot hitting with his 32nd home run of the season and the San Francisco Giants scored twice in the 10th inning to defeat Pittsburgh 5-4 on Wednesday night, ending the Pirates’ four-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rafael Devers hits 32nd homer, extends hit streak to 10 games as Giants beat Pirates 5-4 in 10

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Vladimir Guerrero Jr. hit a three-run homer and had a season-high five RBI, Dylan Cease scattered four hits over six innings and the Toronto Blue Jays routed the Cleveland Guardians 11-0 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guerrero drives in 5 runs, Blue Jays rout Guardians 11-0 to tighten AL wild-card race

headlines.description: — Spencer Torkelson hit a two-run home run in the 12th inning, Javier Báez added a bases-clearing double, and the Detroit Tigers beat the Minnesota Twins 11-6 on Wednesday night to salvage the final game of a three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Torkelson homers to start 5-run 12th, Tigers top Twins 11-6

events.name: Miami Marlins at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Kyle Stowers homered and had an RBI single, Heriberto Hernández drove in two runs and the Miami Marlins rallied to beat the Kansas City Royals 9-6 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stowers homers and has an RBI single, Marlins rally to beat the Royals 9-6

headlines.description: — Jackson Chourio homered and the Milwaukee Brewers beat the Chicago Cubs 9-5 on Wednesday night, overcoming a shaky performance by Jacob Misiorowski.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chourio stars as the Brewers beat the Cubs 9-5 despite shaky start by Misiorowski

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Nelson Velázquez hit a two-run single in the eighth inning to break a scoreless tie, Hayden Wesneski and two relievers combined on a three-hitter and the Houston Astros defeated the Chicago White Sox 2-0 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nelson Velázquez's 2-run single in the 8th inning gives Astros 2-0 win over White Sox

events.name: New York Yankees at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Cam Schlitter gave up one run and two hits in eight superb innings, and the New York Yankees scored five two-out runs in 10th in a 6-3 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schlittler sharp, the Yankees score 5 2-out runs in the 10th in a 6-3 win over the Angels

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Thomas Saggese hit a go-ahead, two-strike infield single in the 10th inning and the St. Louis Cardinals outlasted the Los Angeles Dodgers 8-6 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saggese hits go-ahead single in the 10th in the Cardinals' 8-6 victory over the Dodgers
